svg.title: SYN Mirror: how the server finds a meeting point whose address changes
svg.text: How the server finds a meeting point whose address changes

g.text: Read: the next read key@S of the line
UDP, 16 bytes; up to 3 tries, 1 s each
The address and the port of the meeting point
@: ask it for a port, the same id =: knock the key
30 s later: read again, from the top
moved: there with the same id or key; a new line
